name: POST /api/speech/catalog/:entry_id/certification-runs - Certify a catalog entry for this tenant with its own key
description: Tenant route (Bearer JWT). Queues a TENANT-scope certification run: a pass certifies the entry for this tenant only (its stack profiles then treat the layer as tenant_certified), a fail withdraws the tenant's earlier certification. Body: binding_id (the tenant's key for the entry's provider and layer), reference_binding_id (required for stt — a tts key — and tts — an stt key), reference_model?, reference_voice?. 202 { run }. A catalog entry is certified only after its certification run passes the thresholds (c1171be1-c7ce-4c6d-acbc-98ffe825bc53#AC2): llm — tool-call accuracy, p95 time to first token, barge-in stop; stt — word error rate of phone-band (8 kHz) audio a reference TTS synthesised, and time to the final transcript; tts — time to first audio, real-time factor, intelligibility through a reference STT. Keys come from the tenant key vault; ProjexCloud holds none. An operator can no longer set certified by PATCH (409 CertificationRequiresRun). Errors: wrong/missing key 400; unknown entry 404; a run of the entry already in progress 409; no token 401. The chain's key is an OpenAI llm key and the catalog lists stt entries first, so certifying entries.0 with it is refused (400 'binding_id is a llm key; this entry needs a stt key') — a real run needs the tenant's own key for the entry's provider and, for stt/tts, a reference key of the other layer; runs are executed by the voice runtime.

testCases.name: The chain's llm key cannot certify an stt entry -> 400

errorCases.message: binding_id is a llm key; this entry needs a stt key
errorCases.when: the key does not fit the entry, or a reference key is missing

errorCases.message: a certification run of this entry is already in progress
